# E0230: a minor version constrains a field by another field's value, which the checker cannot compare

The compatibility checker compares each field's constraint between the two
schemas. A field constrained by another field's value has no constraint of its
own to compare, so the checker cannot decide, and a minor version it cannot
decide about does not bind: change the schema so the checker can decide, or
make it a major version.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				b?: a
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				b?: >a
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0230]: b in schema v0.1 is constrained by a in both schemas, differently; the checker cannot compare constraints between fields
  --> lineage.cue:13:5
   |
13 |                 b?: >a
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema v0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data schema v0.0 accepts
   = help: change the schema so the checker can decide, or make this version v1.0
```
